integrity.origin_and_attribution: Fang--Fourier--Litza--Pegel construction and combinatorial constancy credited as prior work; the minimum enclosing ball statement is the assessment target.
integrity.proof_type: analytic; complete vertex hull plus exact distance gaps and contact-barycenter variance certificate

scientific_limitations: Only complete two-level marked posets with p,q >= 2, zero lower transfer parameters, common upper transfer t in [0,1], and ordinary standard-coordinate Euclidean metric are covered.
No statement is made about general marked posets, unequal transfer parameters, inscribed ellipsoids, or affine-invariant outer radii.
A differently phrased equivalent covering-ball result for convex hulls of coordinate cube strata remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp Euclidean minimum-sphere plateau in a two-level family of marked poset polytopes
